source_state: Working tree based on baseline_commit (v0.5.6) with uncommitted compressor changes: a shared SIMD prefilter of the sixteen distance-cache probes (compressor::core::cache_probe) used by the q10/q11 Zopfli update_nodes loop and by the q7-q9 greedy bucket matchers (probe_derived_distances); dictionary words compared against the input as one u8x32 in all_matches::find_all, now a #[simd] entry point (q10/q11); and an exact early exit in is_mostly_utf8 (q10/q11). Compressed output is byte-identical to baseline_commit. Decoder sources unchanged from baseline_commit.

affinity: Eight parallel single-threaded lanes pinned to logical CPUs 0,2,4,6,8,10,12,14 (distinct cores in the WSL2 topology), one Criterion process per lane: the encoder sweep sharded by corpus over CPUs 0,2,4,6 and the decoder sweep over CPUs 8,10,12,14, both at once.
rustflags: unset; release defaults, runtime SIMD dispatch
features: comparison default features; no profiling instrumentation
api_mode: cold native decoding, construction/allocation/disposal included; C gets known output capacity
stream_producer: Pinned Google C Brotli one-shot encoder, identical retained streams for every decoder

sampling.note: Criterion defaults of the comparison harness.

corpus_generation: Eight inputs: empty, tiny-text, alice29, text-1m, binary-64k, random-64k, random-1m, repeated-1m, from the pinned core.rs generator (xorshift64 seed 0x243f6a8885a308d3; structured binary ((i/16)^i) mod 256; repeated a; cyclic Alice); streams produced by Google C at q0-q11, window 22.
limitations: One WSL2 host; frequency, thermals and host scheduling uncontrolled.
Fixed decoder order; confidence intervals capture sampling variation, not all environmental bias.
C receives known output capacity; Rust Vec APIs grow output during decode; Rust brotli includes 4 KiB I/O adaptation.
Only cold APIs and C-generated standard-window streams; no streaming, reuse or dictionaries. Historical timings are not paired before/after measurements.

Eight benchmark processes ran at once on separate cores and shared the last-level cache, memory bandwidth and the package's turbo budget; absolute timings are below a single-core sweep and latency cases of tens of nanoseconds (empty input) move most. Ratios to C are the comparable quantity.
Host idle before the sweep: load average 0.13/0.13/0.06 four minutes after a reboot (10:01:59 MSK), no other benchmark, build, test or fuzzing process running.

Cases whose ratio to C fell more than 5% below the 2026-10-02 run were re-timed on the same lanes (39 cases); the confirmed ones were checked with callgrind against v0.5.6 (dba6a473) and 5f39a1d0: instruction counts and page faults match within 0.7%, so those shifts come from the host, not from the code.
timestamps_note: wall-clock date -u taken immediately before the eight lanes started and after the last one ended (encoder and decoder sweeps ran together)
